integrity: Exact harmonic and zeta identities have a standalone exhaustive rational checker for small graph sizes; the infinite statements are proved analytically, not by finite enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two labeled arcs per birth, independently sampled with replacement. This does not establish higher cumulants, mod-Poisson convergence, or growing-degree universality; historical priority remains subject to independent review.
title: Exact second-cumulant matrix for the shortest cycles of a two-parent recursive DAG
